messages:
Ana: Morning — quick release-train check. Canary on rail-5 at 10%, p50/p95 look good but PR #5428 cherry-pick is blocked: `model-compat-tests` failing in integration. Can someone grab it?
Ben: I'll take a look now. Saw a tokenization assert in the logs. Reproduced locally with `ci-runner:v3`.
Dave: Paused automatic promotion for that canary until the cherry lands. :warning:
Ben: Pushed a tiny fix to branch `ben/fix-tokenize` and created a cherry-pick. Triggering CI. If it passes, we can cherry-pick `git cherry-pick -x abc1234` onto `release/rail-5`. cc @Eva for review.
Eva: Reviewing now — small nit inline, otherwise LGTM. Will approve once CI is green.
ci-bot: Build #987654 started for `ben/fix-tokenize` — `model-compat-tests` queued.
Frank: Heads-up: merge queue is at 6 right now; if this sits >20m we risk missing tonight's cut window. Can we rerun the flaky tests in parallel? @eng-sre
ci-bot: Rerun triggered by @Ben — retrying failing jobs (x2).
Ben: Rerun passed except one timing assertion. Replaced `sleep(1)` with event wait, re-run again.
Eva: Approved and left a follow-up comment about test cleanup. @Dave can you merge and promote when green? We'll want to bump canary to 25% manually after merge.
Dave: Merged cherry-pick to `release/rail-5` and bumped canary to 25%. Monitoring metrics now. :rocket:
Ana: Thanks — updating the release dashboard and notes. Any other blockers?
Frank: Tiny follow-up: cherry #5430 (metrics dashboard tweak) still needs docs signoff before prod. Pinged @Hannah.
Hannah: Got it — will publish the doc update in ~15m and link it here.
ci-bot: Build #987654 completed — all checks passed.
Ana: Great — keeping an eye on latency regressions for the next 30m. If anything pops, call it out here. Otherwise closing this check-in. :white_check_mark:
